name: BSP_Profile_FlushPendingUnlocks

name: BSP_Profile_IsUnlockSatisfied
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol; the game's own Lua name for it is Scoring_IsUnlocked (008BBC40). __thiscall(profile = game+650h, const NativeString* expression) returning char, RET 4, SEH frame 00C8FC28. Copies expression->data (or the empty string at 00F8745C when null) into char[256] at ESP+64h with an unbounded copy loop, then walks _strtok(buffer, " ,") at 00D08D18. Any-of: the accumulated result is tested at 007FC554 and returned, so the first satisfied token ends the walk; no tokens means false. Per token, in order: 007FC5A1 ECX = [profile+64h] and 0090C560 (mission completed); 007FC602 004C7F10 find on the set at profile+70h, the saved "Unlocks"; 007FC65B the same find on profile+7Ch, unlocks granted this session; 007FC6C2 005097D0 on the counter map at profile+A0h with TEST/JG, so strictly positive; 007FC6DD 007F8890 on the content list at profile+D0h. All five compare case-insensitively. Seven callers: 007FC820, 00584750 and 0050A400 (VehicleClass UnlockID), 004FAC50 (unlock list, false sets record+45h), 0050EF80, 005C5990, 008BBC40. See docs/PROFILE_UNLOCK_PREDICATE.md.

name: BSP_Profile_TestUnlockRequirements
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(profile, container* requirements) returning char, RET 4. Walks the container first/last pair at requirements+4h/+8h with the iterator-debug bound checks and calls 007FC4C0(profile, element) per element. 005C57D0 calls it with ECX = 00E188A8+650h, the profile block, and the mission record container at record+78h, and starts the mission only when it returns non-zero. The per-element predicate 007FC4C0 was not read, so how one requirement is evaluated is not recovered. See docs/MISSION_TREE_BRIEFING_SCREENS.md. | Per-element predicate now read: 007FC4C0 is BSP_Profile_IsUnlockSatisfied, an any-of over the " ,"-separated tokens of one requirement string. The 8-byte element is a NativeString {length, data}, so record+78h is a vector<NativeString> of requirement expressions and this routine is the all-of over them; 007FC844 returns AL = 1 for an empty vector, which is how the 131 missiontree.lua entries with prerequisites = {} stay open. Second caller 00597870 labels a mission whose requirements fail with the string "confidental". See docs/PROFILE_UNLOCK_PREDICATE.md.

Five callers; 0067cc60, the sign-in handler behind the FE_initial press-start element, runs it before reading the XUID into game+698h. Segment 49 keywords: unlocks, selectedmissionid, selecteddifficulty, seenunlocks, savedlobbyfilters. The return statements the pseudocode emits after free are artifacts of a no-return annotation on 00BF65AC; disasm-raw shows ADD ESP,4 and a fall-through at 007fdc0b and 007fde49. docs/GAME_TITLE_INIT.md | Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Section-keyed profile serializer for the block at game+650h; its string immediates are PlayerProfile, Version, Score, Achievements, Bonus, Unlocks, SeenUnlocks, AllSeenHints, SavedLobbyFilters, arraySize, filterLatency, filterFreeSlots, filterPlayerCount, SelectedMissionID, SelectedDifficulty, Difficulty, Voice, DropRateDC, DropRateTC, AlliedNoseArt, JapanNoseArt. 007FE29C pairs "Unlocks" (00D08C6C) with LEA EBX,[EDI+70h] and 007FE9E2 pairs "SeenUnlocks" (00D08C60) with LEA ECX,[EDI+88h] + 004D0640, so those are the two saved string sets.
